pages.text: Chui Equity Fund factsheet, issued by Mto Asset Managers (SYN). Chui Equity Fund is a equity fund and its objective is to achieve long-term capital growth from listed shares. The management fee of Chui Equity Fund is 3.0 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Chui Equity Fund is SYN Sh 500, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 100. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Chui Equity Fund delivered an effective annual return of 15.7 percent.

Withdrawals from Chui Equity Fund are paid within 1 business days. The main holdings of Chui Equity Fund are retail shares (35 percent), brewery shares (25 percent) and cement shares (20 percent). SYN Trust Company acts as trustee of Chui Equity Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Chui Equity Fund was launched in 2023 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
